description.value: Fishboat — also known as Fishboat Fish & Chippery — is a fish and chips eatery on White Rock's Marine Drive waterfront that has been operating since 2009. It sits on a popular recreational and touring cycling corridor along the Semiahmoo shoreline, with outdoor seating available. The seafront setting makes it a fitting food stop for cyclists exploring the White Rock waterfront and promenade.
